Deskfirst featured as Gartner's 2025 Software Advice Frontrunners.

Deskfirst featured among Gartner's 2025 Software Advice Frontrunners.

Deskfirst, Inc. is excited to share that Deskfirst has been recognized as a 2025 Frontrunner by Software Advice, part of Gartner Digital Markets. Deskfirst appears in the 2025 Collaboration Software Frontrunners Report.

This recognition places Deskfirst among the top-rated tools in the Sales Enablement and Collaboration categories. It strengthens its mission to help teams collaborate better, close deals faster, and create smooth digital experiences for prospects and customers.

Why this recognition matters.

Software Advice evaluates products using a rigorous methodology focused on two key factors: usability and customer satisfaction. Ratings are based on verified, real-world reviews that measure ease of use, feature quality, support responsiveness, value for money, and overall customer experience.

Being included in the Frontrunners report means users consistently rate Deskfirst as one of the most intuitive and effective platforms for sales-driven collaboration.

Deskfirst's role in the future of Sales Enablement.

Deskfirst is designed to empower modern revenue teams. Its platform is becoming a preferred solution for Sales Enablement, Buyer Seller Collaboration, and Digital Sales Rooms. These capabilities help teams improve alignment and reduce friction across every stage of the sales cycle.

* Purpose-built for Sales Enablement
Teams use Deskfirst to centralize materials, personalize client-facing resources, and manage content versioning. This ensures every seller always works with the most accurate and effective assets.
* A Better Buyer Seller Collaboration Experience
Deskfirst replaces scattered email threads, confusing portals, and cluttered file-sharing links with a clean and familiar desktop-style workspace that clients understand immediately. Files, notes, videos, proposals, and next steps stay together in one organized environment.
* Digital Sales Rooms That Feel Intuitive and Human
Deskfirst provides sellers with a branded, interactive space that mirrors a real desktop. Prospects know where to click and how to navigate, which keeps momentum high and eliminates unnecessary friction.

What this recognition means for its users.

* Trusted credibility
A Frontrunner badge gives prospects an independent signal that Deskfirst is reliable, user friendly, and proven.
* Validation of its product direction
This recognition confirms that Deskfirst, Inc. is solving real problems for sales teams. It reflects its success in helping organizations shorten sales cycles, increase client engagement, and create a clear and enjoyable buying experience.
* Motivation to keep improving
Deskfirst, Inc. will continue refining usability, collaboration tools, and sales-focused workflows. Deskfirst, Inc. will also introduce new capabilities that strengthen digital sales experiences from the first call to the closed deal.

A thank you to its community.

This achievement is possible because of its users. Your feedback, reviews, and ongoing trust have placed Deskfirst among the top performers in the 2025 Frontrunners report.

Thank you for choosing Deskfirst as your platform for sales enablement and buyer collaboration.

Looking ahead.

Deskfirst, Inc. is focused on expanding what teams can achieve with Sales Enablement, Buyer Seller Collaboration, and Digital Sales Rooms. Expect even smoother experiences, richer collaboration, and powerful tools that create clarity and momentum throughout the sales journey.

The future of sales is collaborative. Deskfirst is proud to be building the platform that makes this future possible.

About Gartner Digital Markets.

Gartner Digital Markets is the world's largest platform for finding software and services. More than 100 million people visit Capterra, GetApp, Software Advice, and UpCity across over 70 localized sites every year to read objective research and verified customer reviews that help them confidently choose the right software and services. Thousands of B2B companies work with Gartner Digital Markets to build their brand, capture buyer demand, and grow their business. For more information, visit https://www.gartner.com/en/digital-markets

SmartAdvocate wins 2024 Best Legal Case Management Software in New York, New Jersey, and National Law Journals.

SmartAdvocate has been awarded 'Best of 2024' by The New York Law Journal, The New Jersey Law Journal, and The National Law Journal in several categories, including Best Legal Case Management Software.

November 16, 2024 18:36 ET
| Source:
SmartAdvocate

MELVILLE, NY, Nov. 16, 2024 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - SmartAdvocate, a leading provider of fully customizable legal case management software, is thrilled to announce its recognition as a 'Best of 2024' Winner by The New York Law Journal, The New Jersey Law Journal, and The National Law Journal across multiple categories, including Best Legal Case Management Software.

SmartAdvocate has achieved this prestigious honor due to the company's unwavering dedication to delivering innovative solutions that cater to the unique needs of legal professionals nationwide. Allison Rampolla, SVP of Sales & Marketing, remarked, '2024 has been a pivotal year of growth for us at SmartAdvocate, and we're incredibly proud to have been recognized. Along with the Law Journals, we're especially honored to have been recently awarded "Best Customer Support" and "Most Recommended" by Software Advice, a prominent review website. These accolades reflect our commitment to delivering unparalleled support to our clients as we continue to expand our impact across the legal industry'.

This marks the ninth consecutive year that SmartAdvocate has received recognition from The New York Law Journal and The New Jersey Law Journal in 4 categories for: Best Case Management Software, Best Matter Management, Best Practice Management Software and Best Document Management Solution. It is the fourth consecutive win from The National Law Journal for Best Case Management Software, Best Matter Management, Best Time & Billing Software, and Best Docketing and Calendaring Software.

This win across three esteemed law journals underscores SmartAdvocate's role as a trusted, innovative partner within the legal community. By continuously enhancing its powerful, fully integrated platform, SmartAdvocate empowers firms to improve efficiency, optimize workflows, and deliver exceptional client service. These awards affirm SmartAdvocate's ongoing mission to set the standard in legal case management software.

About SmartAdvocate
SmartAdvocate is a fully customizable, case management software with built-in Artificial Intelligence tools, and made to handle the challenges of today's fast paced, highly competitive and technologically demanding legal landscape. SmartAdvocate's robust, exclusive built-in features enable firms to manage, store, track and communicate like never before, ensuring they achieve the highest level of success.

SOURCE: SmartAdvocate

AOD to be bought by MatrixCare.

MatrixCare has entered into a definitive agreement to buy AOD Software.

AOD has more than 800 continuing care retirement communities and 1,400 home health and home care locations as customers.

"The businesses are very complementary," MatrixCare President and CEO John Damgaard told McKnight's. "MatrixCare is strong in senior living segment and AOD is very strong in CCRCs and home health. There's eerily little overlap."

AOD will continue to be based in Fort Lauderdale, FL, with employees focused on those market segments, he said.

"We're obviously communicating with each segment of customers, but it's business as usual other than benefitting from combined resources," Damgaard explained.

Terms of the deal were not released, but it was expected to close "in the near future," he said. While MatrixCare holds a "strong share in every segment," it does not hold the majority shares in any one segment, making it more palatable to regulators and antitrust approval.

"It's still a very competitive market," Damgaard observed.

Springbrook introduces Allocation Water Billing solution.

A new Allocation Water Billing module aims to help municipalities manage complex water billing scenarios.

Springbook Software has released a new Allocation Water Billing module, a solution to help municipalities roll out water conversation strategies with increasingly complex water rates.

Springbook said that the module has been beta tested in California, an area already implementing tiered water allocation billing, and is now available for municipalities across the country.

Allocation billing involves a complex equation based on analysis of multiple variables and a residential "water budget." These variables include the expected amount of water each household is anticipated to use, factoring in the number of residents, size of home, time of day, changes in weather and periods of drought. The calculation is comprised of two primary components, the "indoor" and "outdoor" budget, each with their own calculation rule.

In a budgeted water scenario, each residence is assigned an allocation. Billing tiers are implemented for each budgeted rate, which enable rate increases when usage exceeds allocated amounts.

This functionality builds on Springbrook's existing multi-tiered rate structure which already supports percentage-based consumption tiers for certain use cases.

"Our goal is to help agencies provide equitable water access to our citizenry and relieve the burden on staff for managing complex billing scenarios," said Robert Bonavito, Springbrook CEO. "Allocation billing is a big issue in California, where we pioneered our solution, and it's an issue that we see impacting many other areas. Efficient water uses involves public education and putting the right tools in the hands of local governments and utilities. We know this solution is necessary and are continually working to help agencies stay ahead of nature's curve."

Assistance Software launches Assistance PSA for Microsoft Dynamics CRM 2011.

Assistance
Software, a vendor of solutions for the professional services industry, announced
that it has rolled out a new flagship product, Assistance PSA for Microsoft
Dynamics CRM.

Assistance
PSA, which is intended for today's information worker, is based on Dynamics CRM's
xRM application development framework. The product will enhance the standard Dynamics
CRM functionality with project management, resource planning, time and expense
registration and invoice capabilities and Microsoft SharePoint, according to
the company. It will support multiple deployment options-on-premises, SaaS and
later on Dynamics CRM Online, according to company officials.

The system
streamlines the front office business processes, connects the various units of
an organization and integrates all the relevant information-from CRM to project
management. Assistance Software has worked closely with Microsoft to streamline
project and practice management from first contact to contract to delivery,
company officials said.

"Through
the collaboration with Microsoft we can effectively target the professional
services industry with local support from our worldwide partner network," said Martijn
van der Hoeden, Assistance Software CEO, in a statement. "The combination of
the Dynamics CRM platform with Assistance PSA is unique and is created for the
information worker of today. Furthermore we provide a unique integration with
Microsoft Outlook for easy and very user friendly time sheet registration."

Doug
Kennedy, vice president, Microsoft Dynamics Partners, said Assistance Software
is an example of a partner that is harnessing the power and flexibility of Dynamics
CRM to meet the specific needs of its customers and help them be more
productive.

Linda
Rosencrance is a freelance writer/editor in the Boston area. Rosencrance has
over 25 years experience as an reporter/investigative reporter, writing for
many newspapers in the metropolitan Boston area. Rosencrance has been writing
about information technology for the past 16 years.

She has
covered a variety of IT subjects, including Microsoft Dynamics, mobile security
issues such as data loss prevention, network management, secure mobile app
development, privacy, cloud computing, BI, big data, analytics, HR, CRM, ERP,
and enterprise IT.

Rosencrance
is the author of six true crime books for Kensington Publishing Corp.

Generative AI EHR integration from Oracle.

EMR Software vendors are making strides to roll out new tools and features that help to streamline the clinical documentation process. Most healthcare providers find that tedious documentation and charting add to their stress and can even contribute to physician burnout.

What is Oracle Clinical Digital Assistant?

Oracle Cerner EMR Software system has announced a generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) tool to help with clinical documentation. The AI tool will be available in a year for providers. The Clinical Digital Assistant by Oracle leverages the power of voice commands to reduce manual entry tasks for clinicians which can provide them more time to focus on patient care. Automating the clinical documentation process can build patient trust, and enhance healthcare delivery.

The key benefits of Generative AI EHR Software integration.

The Generative AI EMR integration from the Oracle EHR Software system has many advantages for both patients and healthcare providers.

The generative Oracle Clinical Digital Assistant enables physicians to concentrate on their patients during patient encounters. The undivided attention of the provider helps to boost patient satisfaction scores.

The powerful tool automates note-taking and suggests context-aware steps to take this includes ordering medications and scheduling labs.

The digital assistant can also respond promptly to any clinician queries.

The generative AI EMR Software integration will allow for personalized care and improved patient encounters.

Patient engagement with Oracle Clinical Digital Assistant.

The generative AI capabilities can drive patient engagement and boost empowerment as patients can easily take self-service actions. They can use voice commands to schedule appointments and pay their medical bill. Patients can even ask questions related to their symptoms, healthcare conditions, or surgical procedures.

Moving ahead.

The use of simple voice commands not only streamlines the clinical documentation process but also enables providers to focus on patient engagement which can be ignored leading to dissatisfaction. Now with Oracle's generative AI EHR Software systems integration clinicians will spend less time on the screen and give complete attention to the patient.

The one-on-one doctor and patient interaction is essential for optimal healthcare delivery and can have a major impact on patient outcomes and satisfaction scores. When less time is spent on clinical documentation, the doctor and patient can have a more meaningful and useful contact leading to patient-centered care.

Ventiv Technology named in the leader category for RMIS solutions by AMRAE and EY.

Ventiv Technology, the leading provider of risk, insurance, and underwriting solutions, announced that Ventiv IRM has been identified as a market leader in three categories in the2023 Risk Management Information Systems (RMIS) Panorama report published by AMRAE and EY. This recognition confirms Ventiv’s continued innovation and long-held position as a market leader in the industry.

Partnering with AMRAE and EY, the RMIS Panorama is a technical report that analyzes market practices and trends based on risk managers and vendors across the globe. The RMIS Panorama uses 3 fundamental principles to conduct the market analysis: neutrality, objectivity, and business orientation. Plus, the results from this survey of 249 risk managers worldwide.

In this report, Ventiv IRM and Ventiv Predict was recognized as an industry leader in the categories of Analytics, Quality, and Insurance Risk Management. A full copy of the report is available here.

Subscribe by Email

With Ventiv Patient Safety, Ventivtech has all of its claims and incident data in one system, and Ventivtech can better understand event trends and drivers with advanced analytics and reporting.

One of the key benefits Ventivtech get from Ventiv is enhanced efficiency. It allows its adjusters to navigate easily through the different components of the claim and put more focus on getting an optimal outcome for the injured worker.

Ventivtech has more than ten-year relationship with Ventiv. There’s a really strong level of trust in its relationship, which gives Ventivtech confidence that the team at Ventiv is advising Ventivtech based on their experience with Ventivtech and knowing what Ventivtech need and why.

Working with an experienced provider like Ventiv Technology is an important precondition of achieving its goals and furthering the mission of the County of Los Angeles.

Having the Ventiv team’s guidance was such a great benefit for HPIC. There were many times Ventivtech turned to Ventiv to ask what other Ventiv clients in its line of work were doing; access to best practices is something Ventivtech really appreciated.
